authority.audio: Measured physical events and authored acoustic parameters; no audible rendering

cases.family: A ramp reaches the upper row, with a clustered contact and later receiving strike.
A close pair opens into a later receiving note.
A displaced low launch crosses between a ramp, raised plate and lower receivers.
A short simultaneous pair can split into a single strike.
A western ramp approach reaches an upper plate and its middle receiver.
A low outward miss reaches ground without sound.
A high carry misses the voiced geometry.

resources.scope: Runtime-only; excludes presentation, launcher, trails and shadows

limits: ok means valid inputs and completed actual physics, NOT a musical quality or accessibility score
Sounding impacts and qualified sport redirects are separate ledgers
Neighbor rejections remain explicit; no clamping to manufacture apparent sensitivity
Original collision timings and pitches are not quantized
No browser rendering, listening, GPU draw calls or phone frame timing measured
